name: Sacra
description:
Bring Sacra research & data into Claude to use trusted data on growth & pre-IPO technology companies into your chats, investment memos, meeting prep and more.

All Sacra research & data is available including:
* company & market reports and expert interviews accessible via search
* revenue estimates & models as structured data
* round-by-round funding data including valuation and price per share

For investors, VCs & corp dev: produce investment memo first drafts, quickly answer diligence questions, build comps, compare business models, track funding and key milestones, and pull the most relevant context from Sacra coverage—without hopping between tabs.

For founders & operators: map competitors, understand category dynamics, sanity-check positioning, and generate crisp briefs you can drop into a memo, deck, or internal update.

For analysts: turn messy questions into structured outputs (bulleted takeaways, peer lists, “what changed?” updates) grounded in your Sacra data.

Available to all Sacra users from free through standard, pro and platform, with usage limits determined by the plan level.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sacra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sacra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sacra.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sacra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sacra provides these MCP tools: get_all_company_domains, get_category_items, get_companies_ranked_by_metric, get_company_profile, get_document_content, get_funding_rounds_for_company, get_news_for_company, get_recent_documents, get_recent_news, get_revenue_signals, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sacra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sacra in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Sacra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sacra is developed by Sacra Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
